zip_caveats: Everyone in these ZIPs votes a Mobile County ballot, so the U.S. House race (all of Mobile County is in District 1 this year), the sheriff, revenue commissioner and district judge races, and both county measures are the same for all of them. What changes by address: your State Senate district (22, 33, 34 or 35), your State House district (97 through 105), and whether you have a school board race (only Districts 3 and 4 vote this year). ZIPs 36602, 36603 and 36604 are almost all House District 97 and Senate District 33. Most split: 36605 (Senate 33 or 35; House 103, 105 or 97), 36606 (House 103 or 97), 36607 (House 99 or 103), 36608 (Senate 34; House 101, 100, 102 or 99), 36609 (Senate 34, 35 or 33; House 103, 104 or 101), 36610 (House 97 or 98), 36617 (House 99 or 98), 36611 (mostly Senate 22, the Chickasaw area), 36618 (Senate 33 or 34; House 99 or 98), 36619 (Senate 35; House 104, 105 or 100), 36693 (Senate 35 or 33; House 103 or 104) and 36695 (Senate 35 or 34; House 100, 105, 104 or 101). Several ZIPs reach outside the city limits: by Census boundaries only about 15% of 36611 (Chickasaw), 30% of 36608 and 36695 (west Mobile), 39% of 36619 (Tillmans Corner) and 45% of 36610 (Prichard area) is inside the City of Mobile. Those district splits come from our overlay of Census boundary files, not an official list, so check your exact districts with your address at myinfo.alabamavotes.gov or on the county's precinct district listing.
